episode.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Crop to content, then select one floor-sized corner.
  (let* ([sub (crop-to-content g 0)]
         [h (quotient (rows sub) 2)]
         [w (quotient (cols sub) 2)]
         [top (- (rows sub) h)]
         [left 0])
    (crop sub top left (- (+ top h) 1) (- (+ left w) 1)))))

limitations: Only the four declared corners and retained episode seeds are evidenced.
The production generator and selected canonical Racket authority remain unchanged.
This is a proposed prototype, not catalog approval or a production parametric API.

parameter.input_constraint: selected-generator inputs must make all four floor-sized corner windows distinct
parameter.name: corner
parameter.selection: one deterministic SHA-256-derived value per episode seed
